notes.title: EA PATCH 1.3
notes.notes:
Small Update and fixed few minor bugs.
*Now you can ignite / Activate the fireworks only once
*Fixed Spawning the fireworks when in inventory
*Fixed Igniting the fireworks when in inventory

Also, I would like to thank our Discord members for bringing the bugs to my attention!
